rows.note: Use X光 as the all-purpose term for X-ray radiation itself, rather than X光片 or X光機.

example.english: The doctor said this examination uses X-ray to see the bones clearly.
example.traditional: 醫生話呢種檢查會用X光睇清楚骨頭。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ni1 zung2 gim2 caa4 wui5 jung6 ek1 gwong1 tai2 cing1 co2 gwat1 tau4

rows.note: Use X光片 specifically for the radiographic image or film produced by an X-ray examination.

example.english: Remember to bring that X-ray to your follow-up appointment tomorrow.
example.traditional: 你聽日記得攞埋嗰張X光片返去覆診。
example.jyutping: nei5 ting1 jat6 gei3 dak1 lo2 maai4 go2 zoeng1 ek1 gwong1 pin3 faan1 heoi3 fuk1 can2

rows.note: Use X光機 specifically for the machine used to take X-rays, not for the radiation or the resulting image.

example.english: The X-ray machine is broken, so we can't do the examination today.
example.traditional: 部X光機壞咗，今日做唔到檢查。
example.jyutping: bou6 ek1 gwong1 gei1 waai6 zo2 gam1 jat6 zou6 m4 dou2 gim2 caa4
